I am very disappointed with the service provided.
We had planned to travel to the UK and booked this appointment several weeks ago. At the time, I was clearly told that the appointment on 1 May was confirmed. However, when we arrived on the day, the clinic was closed, and we had not been informed of any cancellation in advance.
This is unacceptable, especially given the strict timing requirements for entering the UK with a pet. Your failure to notify us nearly caused us to miss the required treatment window, which could have seriously impacted our travel plans.
If the clinic was going to be closed for a holiday, the appointment should never have been scheduled. If it needed to be cancelled, we should have been contacted well in advance.
This lack of communication and responsibility is extremely disappointing.
Your kind words truly make us happy! Our team works hard every day to provide attentive and professional service. Knowing that you appreciate our work is the best reward. Thank you for your trust!

I brought my dog ​​there limping, and instead of taking an X-ray, the vet grabbed his paw and started bending it up and down like a game to check if it was broken.
My dog ​​is hypoallergenic, and the vet gave him a handful of kibble without asking my permission. I didn't even have time to tell her that my dog ​​had eaten it all.
Of course, now, on top of his paw, he's also itching.
I'd say it's unprofessional.
